Y’ALL The final trailer for Toy Story 5 just dropped, and it may have just revealed the return of one of the most important characters in Pixar history: EMILY.

While she only appears briefly in Toy Story 2's iconic "When She Loved Me" sequence, Emily's decision to abandon Jessie shaped the entire future of the character—and arguably changed Pixar forever.

Now, thanks to some hidden clues throughout the final Toy Story 5 trailer, it looks like Jessie may finally get the closure she (and we) have been waiting for FOR decades!

Plus, if Emily really is returning... could Pixar finally be revisiting one of the oldest Toy Story theories of all time?  Is Emily actually Andy's Mom?
